avoid_supplements.name: High-dose chromium
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate insulin effect and increase hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under medical supervision with frequent glucose monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: Vanadium
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance insulin sensitivity and potentiate glucose-lowering effects
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use and monitor blood glucose closely

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May improve insulin sensitivity and enhance glucose uptake
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; dose adjustments may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May lower blood glucose levels and enhance insulin action
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for hypoglycemia; coordinate use with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Bitter melon
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have glucose-lowering properties and potentiate insulin effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose regularly; coordinate timing and dosing

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive intake)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Impairs gluconeogenesis and increases hypoglycemia risk; delays glucose absorption
avoid_foods.action: Limit or avoid alcohol; if consumed, do so with food and monitor glucose closely

caution_foods.name: High-glycemic carbohydrates
caution_foods.mechanism: Rapid glucose spikes may require timing adjustment relative to NPH injection
caution_foods.action: Space meals appropriately; coordinate carbohydrate intake with NPH action curve

caution_foods.name: High-fiber foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May slow glucose absorption and affect insulin requirement timing
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent fiber intake; monitor glucose patterns for dose adjustments

monitoring_notes: NPH insulin requires consistent meal timing and carbohydrate intake; monitor blood glucose before meals and at bedtime to assess hypoglycemia risk, particularly with supplements or dietary changes that affect glucose metabolism. Any substance altering glucose homeostasis warrants dose reassessment and increased glucose monitoring frequency.
